title: screen-plan-{session}.json
description: Step 6.b output. Deterministic ranker output: a single ranked list of findings (top-K cap) plus the screening prompt. Replaces the prior shard-plan / shard-fanout model with a single screener call at 6.c. See apex-core.md step 6.b.

ranked.description: Findings sorted by deterministic relevance score (descending). Top-K cap applied; entries below the cap are dropped with a _meta.dropped_below_cap warning.

score.description: Deterministic relevance score in [0, 1] computed by _rank_findings.py (layer-count + confidence + path-token-overlap - size-penalty).

screening_prompt.description: Shared template with hypothesis injected verbatim. Consumed by the single screener call at 6.c.

findings_count.description: Total findings entries before any --min-confidence filter.

dropped_below_cap.description: Findings dropped because the top-K cap was hit (signal that hypothesis was too broad).

deterministic_count.description: Findings entries with at least one deterministic-layer reason (static-imports/ast-grep/framework/lsp). With ripgrep retired in v1.x, equals findings_count for any non-empty findings.json.

min_confidence.description: --min-confidence flag passed to rank-findings.sh (default medium = no filter; high drops medium-confidence entries).
